method: Freshly exported the installed original level1/level2/level3. Parsed the actual Vercel JavaScript native-course literals without executing the bundle. Compared every road vertex, normal, UV, triangle index, route point, width, start/finish pose, gate, colliding tree placement and mud trigger.

regressions.checks: Original file identity and road fingerprints across three seeds and both modes; default Stage01.

findings: The inspected Vercel and Sites JavaScript bundles are byte-identical.
All three original road layouts match the fresh installed-game export exactly at its six-decimal storage precision.
Live Vercel rooms select the correct native routes for profiles6/7/8 and both clients agree.
Earlier builds selected procedural Stage04 by default. Current source and live build default to original Stage01. Existing sessions can resume their previous selected route.
limits: This does not establish which cached build, saved room or local LAN checkout was on the user device during the reported run.
A complete native-rendering or manual driving parity claim is outside this route-data comparison.
coordination: No LAN, networking, audio, renderer or game route data changed by this audit.

tunnelVerification.scope: Two temporary test clients in a separate room; both left and sockets closed after verifying each stage. Existing players and LAN configuration were not modified.
